title: 🌀 Pseudo-3D Spaces

accepted_baseline.label: Two-map monumental Spaces + fixed frontal camera

current_candidate.summary: Spaces v13 applies a universal camera-source lighting model to both maps, makes distance falloff strongly nonlinear with near-black zones, updates Map 1 floor/walls/arches to the same dramatic lighting system, and rebuilds Map 2 as a diagonal palace of much thicker brutalist columns.

open_feedback: Review whether both maps now feel sculpted by a light carried by the camera rather than uniformly lit.
Review Map 2 diagonal palace composition: columns should not read as horizontal rows.
Review Map 2 mass: columns should feel wide/heavy/brutalist, not like thin tubes.
Review floors: near camera readable, distance and off-axis regions can fall almost completely into black.
